value.title: Fold a ruling into the project docs
value.summary: Fold a ruling into the PRD, blueprint and workstream it changes: find the rows, amend them with changelog rows, validate everything, tell the owner.

value.who: The PM that owns the affected docs, or the prime.
value.when: After a ruling (the operator's, or the prime's within the operator's rulings) changes what a PRD, blueprint or workstream says. Run it with `--key <ruling id>`.

value.title: Find every row the ruling touches
value.done_when: You have the list of requirement rows, components and steps it changes, including those that link to them.

value.title: Amend the rows and add changelog rows
value.done_when: Each affected row is amended (never deleted), new rows take the next free id, dropped rows say why, and each changed doc has a changelog row naming the ruling.

value.title: Validate every project doc
value.done_when: Every document under docs/project validates clean and every rendering is current.

value.title: Tell the owner
value.done_when: If a plan's acceptance criteria quote the old wording, its owner has the changed row ids.

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: Every doc the ruling touches says what the ruling says, with a changelog row naming it, and all project docs validate.

value.text: Validating every document takes one ddocs launch per document.
Editing only the PRD: links cross files, so components and steps that point at a changed row need checking too.

value.guarantees: Folding a ruling in is this procedure; the old page points here.
